note: Shared subcircuits, referenced from netlists as {"type":"sub","of":"lib:<name>"}. Speakers are Thiele–Small electrical equivalents (Re + Le + (Le2 || Re2) lossy voice coil in series with the motional parallel RLC: Res = Re·Qms/Qes, Lces = Re/(2π·fs·Qes), Cmes = Qes/(2π·fs·Re)); parameters are approximate datasheet-class values, labelled per block.

spk-12in-8ohm-american.note: 12-inch 8 Ω American ceramic/alnico speaker class (Jensen C12N-type), approximate (Re 6.0 Ω, fs 100 Hz, Qms 3.0, Qes 0.7); voice coil: Le 0.2 mH + (0.7 mH || 22 ohm) eddy-current (semi-inductance) branch, fitted to typical published impedance curves so the load turns resistive above a few kHz instead of rising as an ideal inductor

spk-12in-8ohm-british.note: 12-inch 8 Ω British 25 W class (Celestion G12M-type), approximate (Re 6.4 Ω, fs 75 Hz, Qms 4.6, Qes 0.6); voice coil: Le 0.15 mH + (0.6 mH || 20 ohm) eddy-current (semi-inductance) branch, fitted to typical published impedance curves so the load turns resistive above a few kHz instead of rising as an ideal inductor

spk-12in-16ohm-british.note: 12-inch 16 Ω British 25 W class (Celestion G12M-type, 16 Ω), approximate (Re 12.8 Ω, fs 75 Hz, Qms 4.6, Qes 0.6); voice coil: Le 0.3 mH + (1.2 mH || 40 ohm) eddy-current (semi-inductance) branch, fitted to typical published impedance curves so the load turns resistive above a few kHz instead of rising as an ideal inductor

spk-10in-8ohm-american.note: 10-inch 8 Ω American speaker class (Jensen P10R-type), approximate (Re 6.0 Ω, fs 120 Hz, Qms 3.0, Qes 0.75); voice coil: Le 0.15 mH + (0.6 mH || 20 ohm) eddy-current (semi-inductance) branch, fitted to typical published impedance curves so the load turns resistive above a few kHz instead of rising as an ideal inductor
